name: prose-outline
description: Outlines for prose: brief to checkable outline, draft to implied outline, outline diffs, per-project persistence with undo.

interface.shortDescription: Turns a brief into a checkable outline and reads a draft back into the outline it implies.
interface.longDescription: One skill, no agents. prose-outline turns a brief into a voice-outline/1 proposal — thesis, ordered claims, evidence slots, open questions, or acts, beats and turns in beat-sheet mode — and saves it per project in the shared writing-identity registry only after you approve, with undo. A dependency-free scanner reads a draft back into its implied outline (heading tree, topic-sentence candidates, claim-marker density, transitions, section balance) so the structure critic in prose-review has something counted to judge; a differ compares two outline revisions by node id. It proposes and measures; it never drafts, never scores, and never says who wrote anything.
defaultPrompt: Outline this essay from my brief
What does this draft actually argue, section by section?
Diff the outline against last week's version
